scope: Audit-product workflow and interface inspiration; primary design track
method: Official public operational help, guides, release notes and explicitly labeled vendor lifecycle descriptions. No commercial tenant or live-product usability test.

patterns.name: Phase-to-document drill-through

sources.title: Work Flow Panel
sources.limits: Audit2025/27 template reference, not all Cloud products

documented_interaction.actions: Select a phase step and open its associated documents; use the document tree when useful
documented_interaction.result: Work is reachable through process and document contexts
documented_interaction.correction: Return to the tree to tailor file contents

audit_fit.adaptation: Use readiness rows and stage tiles that open exact underlying work. Preserve a searchable form index alongside process navigation; form numbering does not impose order.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Applicable work units, explicit readiness predicates, permitted engagement scope and exact target IDs

patterns.verification: Given a stage with two unresolved items, opening its count lists those same permitted items and each row opens its owning work.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Anchored review history

sources.title: Add and complete review notes
sources.limits: Global Statutory Reporting example; exact role policy is product-specific

documented_interaction.actions: Create an issue in context, inspect replies/status history, resolve or clear
documented_interaction.result: Context and retained issue history remain inspectable
documented_interaction.correction: Resolved issues remain available rather than being deleted

audit_fit.adaptation: Anchor a note to a field/procedure/revision. Keep preparer response separate from authorized reviewer clearance. Show open, responded, cleared and reopened history.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Note target/version/anchor, actual preparer and assigned reviewer; per-work policy governs clearance

patterns.verification: Given an open note, saving a preparer response leaves it unresolved until its permitted reviewer clears it.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Applicability-led programme tailoring

sources.title: Workpaper Planning Activities
sources.limits: US GAAS content pack; other packs vary

documented_interaction.trigger: Practitioner configures and plans engagement work
documented_interaction.actions: Choose relevant content/applicability and connect assessed risks to responses
documented_interaction.correction: Reconsider affected content when circumstances change

audit_fit.adaptation: Show why a procedure applies and its risk/assertion link. Preserve unanswered applicability as unknown. Draft unrelated sections while a decision is pending.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Adopted methodology version, applicability decision/reason, risk/response/procedure IDs and change history

patterns.verification: Given a revised risk, show the affected responses and retain prior procedures/answers until an explicit tailoring decision.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Include review demand in the plan

sources.title: Workpaper Planning Activities
sources.limits: A methodology example, not a calendar/scheduling-engine specification

documented_interaction.actions: Assign responsibilities, dates, resources and review time
documented_interaction.result: Preparation and review work have planned owners/windows

audit_fit.adaptation: Use shared assignment records in timeline/calendar/task views. Separate preparation duration from review bookings and significant decision milestones.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Named capacity, assignee, due date, estimates and separate planned/actual dates; delegated scheduling authority

patterns.verification: Changing a permitted planned task date updates its calendar/timeline without altering an actual performed-at timestamp.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Status-rich workpaper index

sources.title: Using the Engagement View
sources.locator: Index grid columns and notes pane

documented_interaction.actions: Filter/navigate indexed work and inspect notes/status/attribution
documented_interaction.result: Review demand is visible without opening every file
documented_interaction.correction: Open the associated notes or owning content

audit_fit.adaptation: Provide a compact index with reference, title, current state, preparer, reviewer, due date, open notes and changed-after-review marker. Use text and icons, not color alone.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Current permitted population, exact status definitions, review assignments and revisions

patterns.verification: A reviewer can filter submitted work, inspect an exact record and return to the same queue context.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Visible change after review

sources.title: Workpaper Monitor Overview
sources.locator: Editing activity and changes after sign-off
sources.limits: Native applications/Monitor required; behavior is not our snapshot policy

documented_interaction.actions: Save changed content; index indicates post-review changes
documented_interaction.result: Reviewer can identify content changed since sign-off

audit_fit.adaptation: Retain immutable submitted/reviewed snapshots and mark the new working revision as requiring impact assessment. Include evidence-link changes, not only textarea edits.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Snapshot ID, current/submitted/reviewed versions and downstream reliance links

patterns.verification: After changing reviewed work, the prior signed snapshot remains visible and the new revision does not inherit its review.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Personal next-action dashboard

sources.title: Getting Started with AuditFile
sources.limits: Public guide; current tenant behavior not executed

documented_interaction.trigger: Practitioner signs in or receives a review comment
documented_interaction.result: The practitioner reaches work needing attention
documented_interaction.correction: Return to the relevant action after feedback

audit_fit.adaptation: Build distinct role landing queues with next owner/action, engagement context, due date and blocker. Submitted review, returned preparation and partner decisions are different queues.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Work assignment plus capacity and access scope; exact note/work IDs; defined badge counts

patterns.verification: A returned workpaper appears for the preparer with the reason, while its reviewer sees it waiting on the preparer.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Separate workpaper and procedure progress

sources.title: New Features
sources.limits: Optional status does not affect procedure/engagement progress

documented_interaction.actions: Track individual workpaper status separately from procedure review
documented_interaction.result: Supporting-work status is distinguishable from overall progress
documented_interaction.correction: Keep or reconsider prior-year content selectively

audit_fit.adaptation: Separate preparation submitted, required review, evidence gaps and milestone readiness. Expose each numerator/denominator and drill-through population.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Applicable units, current revision rules, authorized N/A and independent review requirements

patterns.verification: One completed attachment cannot mark an incomplete procedure reviewed or an engagement ready for issue.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Blank judgments and stable table orientation

sources.title: Product Release Timeline
sources.limits: Features and template behavior may vary by region/edition

documented_interaction.trigger: Preparer works through a long programme
documented_interaction.actions: Use a blank conclusion until selected, sticky headers and outstanding-work filtering

audit_fit.adaptation: Render typed source choices with no fabricated default conclusion. Keep procedure/assertion headers visible and offer an unanswered/returned filter.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Source schema, explicit null/false/zero/N/A distinctions and required-to-progress rules

patterns.decision: Adopt blank initial judgment; adapt table pattern; priority P0
patterns.verification: Opening a new form leaves its conclusion unanswered; filtering outstanding work retains all applicable unanswered procedures.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Mapping defects before export

sources.title: Product Release Timeline
sources.limits: A specific integration capability, not a generic import guarantee

documented_interaction.actions: Review suggested mappings and unresolved accounts, then export
documented_interaction.result: Unmapped accounts are exposed before use
documented_interaction.correction: Correct mapping and reuse approved mappings

audit_fit.adaptation: Use a data-hub preview showing accepted/quarantined/excluded rows and unmapped/ambiguous accounts. Retain original package, mapping version and reconciliation bridge.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Dataset scope/version, row lineage and reviewer-approved mapping; no live provider connection assumed

patterns.verification: An unmapped account remains visible and cannot disappear into a zero residual or a successful financial-statement bridge.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Request table with review inspector

sources.title: Managing requests
sources.limits: Visibility is independent of status; client notifications not implied locally

documented_interaction.trigger: Information request needs response or review
documented_interaction.actions: Open table row in Overview/Comments/Activity; send for review; complete or request changes
documented_interaction.result: Request handoff and remaining work are visible
documented_interaction.correction: Changes requested routes work back to its responsible party

audit_fit.adaptation: Use an item-level request register and inspector. Distinguish requested, partial receipt, received awaiting evaluation, accepted and rejected. Link exact received evidence versions.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Request owner/source contact, entity/period, due date, receipt/version and evaluator authority

patterns.verification: Receiving one of three required items leaves the request partial; evaluator rejection creates a specific next action rather than marking complete.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Defined progress and waiting-time drill-through

sources.title: Fieldguide Insights
sources.locator: Milestone Status; Engagement Progress; Request Cycle Time; permissions
sources.limits: Premium/Enterprise and explicit Insights permissions; not a quality score

documented_interaction.actions: Filter engagement/milestone/request metrics and drill into details
documented_interaction.result: Open work and waiting periods are identifiable
documented_interaction.correction: Act on the actual underlying request or work

audit_fit.adaptation: Add separate review waiting, evidence waiting, overdue and milestone readiness views with as-of date and exact population. Display unknown/stale data explicitly.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Status entry time, current milestone definition, visibility scope and metric freshness

patterns.verification: Opening an overdue count yields the same permitted rows under the displayed as-of/date definition.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Result-to-evidence anchor

sources.title: Document Matching
sources.limits: v5+; advanced features vary; no OCR implementation inferred

sources.title: Document Matching FAQs
sources.limits: Manual edits may be overwritten by the vendor rerun behavior

documented_interaction.actions: Open the result's source reference and evaluate the supporting document
documented_interaction.result: A machine match is inspectable at source
documented_interaction.correction: Adjust supported parameters or record an exception

audit_fit.adaptation: Display result/evidence side by side with page/cell anchor, source version and human disposition. Preserve previous runs and manual conclusions when rerunning.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: EvidenceUse stable ID, anchor, actual source availability, run ID and reviewer

patterns.decision: Adapt anchor mechanism; defer OCR; priority P1
patterns.verification: Selecting an exception opens the exact supporting source version; a rerun retains the old result and does not erase a manual investigation.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Versioned analysis with explainable exceptions

sources.title: Run an analysis
sources.limits: Run history and risk-range application have different semantics

sources.title: Transaction and entry details
sources.locator: Data table to detail; contributing control points
sources.limits: Specialist signals are not a professional conclusion

documented_interaction.trigger: Required data is ready or a prior run is stale
documented_interaction.actions: Run analysis, inspect results and contributing signals, rerun after relevant input/settings changes
documented_interaction.result: Results are linked to an execution and explainable inputs
documented_interaction.correction: Retain prior runs and reassess changed-source use

audit_fit.adaptation: Create a common automation run panel with input/method versions, parameters, readiness, running/failed/complete states, exception reasons and stale markers. No risk-scoring model is claimed.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Immutable input/run IDs, supported deterministic method, configuration version and human dispositions

patterns.verification: A changed source marks prior results stale and requires a new run; a failed run never shows a clean zero-exception result.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Confirmation lifecycle register

sources.title: Confirm
sources.locator: Confirmations Lifecycle; Tracking & Collaboration; Evidence Finalisation
sources.evidence_type: Official product lifecycle with captioned UI references
sources.limits: Vendor-described workflow; provider connectivity and verification not tested

documented_interaction.trigger: Auditor prepares or follows a confirmation case
documented_interaction.actions: Create request, track sub-status, review response, flag exceptions and export case material
documented_interaction.result: Request, response and evaluated outcome remain distinct
documented_interaction.correction: Reject insufficient responses or resolve exceptions

audit_fit.adaptation: Provide a confirmation case with recipient/source, authority, actual dispatch, response, discrepancy, alternative work and conclusion. Maintain an explicit manual/simulated channel.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Case ID, authorization evidence, actual event provenance and assigned evaluator

patterns.decision: Adapt case register; defer live network; priority P1
patterns.verification: A received response is not automatically accepted; unresolved discrepancies remain visible with a next owner.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately

patterns.name: Authorization before initiation

sources.title: How it works
sources.locator: How do I send confirmations? five-step sequence
sources.limits: Older regional page; current UI, terms and availability require separate verification

documented_interaction.actions: Identify client/responder, obtain client authorization, initiate and retain the response
documented_interaction.result: Authorization and actual request/response events are separated
documented_interaction.correction: Keep unauthorized or unanswered work pending

audit_fit.adaptation: Expose authorization as a named prerequisite with evidence and owner. A manual or simulated dispatch action must say which event was recorded and must not claim provider delivery.
audit_fit.data_and_authority: Actual authorizing party, evidence reference, recipient and dated dispatch/receipt records

patterns.verification: Without actual authorization evidence, initiation remains pending while the auditor can continue drafting the request.
patterns.status: Research recommendation; implementation must be checked separately
